name: superdurable-dex
description: Build Dex process products in a repository-backed coding workspace.

interface.shortDescription: Build Dex apps in a coding workspace
interface.longDescription: Developer skills for a coding-agent host with a writable repository or project workspace. Start with Dex App Builder for end-to-end process products; it loads Dex SDK and routes confirmed official connector gaps to Dex Connector Contributor. Without repository and command access, the plugin supports planning and handoff only.
defaultPrompt: Use $dex-app-builder to discover and design a process application.
Use $dex-app-builder to prototype and build this workflow.
Use $dex-sdk to design a reliable Dex Flow.
Use $dex-connector-contributor to build and upstream this connector capability.
